messages:
maria: Quick sync — PRD for the routing + fallback initiative is up for cross-team review. Link: https://docs.google.com/example_prd (please comment inline). Main asks: confirm launch criteria, rollback policy, telemetry, and edge-case coverage. I pasted the acceptance checklist below. Ping infra/eng/devex/security/sales for sign-off.

aj: Timeline check — we penciled beta for end of Jan. still okay?

kevin: Canary plan suggestion: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback if error-rate >1% OR latency >2x baseline. Need infra quota confirmed for EU GPUs.

lisa: Telemetry requirements: per-model p50/p95 latency, cost-per-token estimates, fallback correctness regression on eval set, and categorized error logs. Who'll own dashboards?

ryan: Customer beta: Acme + BetaCo have volunteered. We need legal opt-in + feature-flag gating. Also want an opt-out path.

devex: Docs/SDK: no breaking API changes expected. We'll add a new 'routing' example and a migration note. Need ~5 working days after the merge to publish guides.

kevin: Infra blocker: Dedicated pool quota in eu-west is at 60% of planned. Raised ticket #INF-1234 to increase.

maria: Acceptance criteria (copy into PRD):
```
- p95 end-to-end latency (hosted) < 350ms for standard 2k seq workload
- Canary rollback triggers: error-rate >= 1% OR p95 latency >= 2x baseline for 10m window
- Fallback model correctness regression < 0.5% on curated eval set
- Console dashboards with alerts for latency, error-rate, and cost-per-token live
- Documentation + SDK examples published and linked from PRD
- Legal sign-off for beta customers (data residency confirmed)
```

lisa: Edge cases to cover in test matrix: tokenizer mismatch between model variants, long-context (>8k) truncation behavior, cold-start spike handling, degraded GPU performance fallbacks. Add compatibility tests for tokenizer/version.

aj: If infra quota is resolved ASAP, timeline stands. Otherwise we should plan a 2-week buffer.

kevin: Escalated INF-1234 to infra leads — they acknowledged, ETA 48h.

security: quick note — EU beta customers must meet data residency checklist. Recommend Private deployment option if legal requires. Also need an encryption-in-transit confirmation for routing metadata.

maria: Decision log (draft): target beta date = 2027-01-15, GA target = 2027-03-01. These are contingent on infra and legal sign-offs.

maria: Action items (owners + rough due timestamps):
- kevin: finalize canary config and open infra PR (due 1799995580)
- lisa: dashboards + alerts setup in Console (due 1799995580)
- devex: SDK examples and migration notes (due 1799996000)
- ryan: customer opt-in + legal agreement (due 1799997000)
- maria: compile final sign-off doc when all +1s received (due 1799997300)

kevin: +1 pending quota increase.

lisa: +1 once dashboards alarms are in place.

aj: +1.

ryan: DMing Acme contact to loop in legal.

sre-bot: deploy-policy template created: template-id=prr-2027-01 (saved to infra repo).

maria: Thanks — I'll pull threads into the sign-off doc and ping product-reviewers channel once infra & legal are green. :wave:
